{{Top|leg}}
The '''orthostatic hypotensive syncope of idiopathic origin''' was the name given by the [[Drongar/Legends|Drongar]] [[Xenobiology|xenobiotic]] [[Ree Ohr]] to an unusual malady that struck [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[CT-914]] during the [[Battle of Drongar]]. The condition was characterized by a very low blood pressure, causing the clone trooper to faint each time he tried to stand. [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] later discovered that the condition was caused by a damage to the trooper's hypothalamus and cured it with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].
